Public scenario summary: phone roaming is disabled while carrier roaming is already allowed. The user wants excellent mobile internet speed and has no Wi-Fi. Follow the supplied mobile-data/roaming support policy. Return only one strict JSON object with exactly this shape: {"schema_version":"tau2-telecom-trajectory-0.1","assistant_message":"your support response","tool_calls":[{"requestor":"user or assistant","name":"tool name","arguments":{}}]}. Tool calls execute in listed order. Use only declared tools and do not add fields, Markdown fences, or prose outside the JSON object. Read-only checks are optional; the final submitted trajectory must leave all native environment assertions satisfied.
